about.title: About London IT Support
paragraphs: At London IT Support, we are proud to be a trusted IT support provider in London, delivering reliable technology and telecom solutions to help local businesses grow. Our mission is simple: to provide fast, proactive, and secure IT services that keep your business running without interruption. We offer a carefully selected range of services tailored for modern SMEs, including managed IT support, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365 support, and business telecom solutions. Whether you need day-to-day helpdesk support or long-term IT strategy, our team ensures your systems stay stable, secure, and ready for growth. From proactive monitoring and maintenance to fully managed telecom and VoIP solutions, we make sure your operations and communications run smoothly so you can focus on what matters most: running and growing your business.

caseStudies.title: Proven Results. Real Business Impact.
caseStudies.intro: See how Intouch Tech helps organisations improve performance, strengthen security and simplify IT with real-world solutions that deliver measurable results.

items.title: Aristone – Scalable VoIP & Connectivity with Intouch Communications
paragraphs: Intouch Communications quickly set up Aristone on our scalable Hosted Communicator VoIP platform, providing local Luton numbers, call recording, remote apps and unlimited support under one simple license.

We recommended Virgin Media for faster broadband, putting the client’s needs first. Since then, Aristone has doubled in size and continues to benefit from a reliable, future-ready communications setup.

items.title: Transforming Patient Communication at Stoneleigh Surgery
paragraphs: InTouch provided a cloud phone system with five times more call capacity, real-time queue updates and separate lines for outbound clinical calls.
We arranged urgent FTTP broadband installation through BT, delivering speeds ten times faster than their previous setup.
Staff can now work securely from any device, and all calls are logged and recorded for improved patient communication.

items.title: The Regis School Upgrades to a Cost-Saving Cloud Phone System
paragraphs: The Regis School was struggling with an outdated on-site ISDN phone system that was costly, space-consuming and difficult to maintain.
After speaking with Intouch, they upgraded to a 3CX Cloud Phone System. This removed the need for in-house maintenance, reduced costs and simplified setup.
Since the switch, the school has saved £3,000 per year and now benefits from a flexible, modern system that supports staff, students and parents effectively.

faq.title: Questions about our London IT support services?

items.question: How quickly can you respond to a support request?
items.answer: Our standard support hours are Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM. We also offer 24/7 support packages for businesses that require round-the-clock assistance. Please contact us for more details on our 24/7 support options. If you contact us, we usually respond within the hour!

items.question: How do you handle cybersecurity?
items.answer: Cybersecurity is a top priority for us. Our range of cybersecurity solutions helps businesses of all sizes protect against cyberattacks. We'll make sure your business has the right measures in place to defend against threats and provide staff training on how to spot potential risks.

items.question: How do you handle data backup and recovery?
items.answer: We offer complete data backup solutions that include regular backups, secure storage, and fast recovery options. Our backup systems are monitored 24/7 and can scale to handle any amount of data. If data loss occurs, our team is ready to restore your data quickly, minimizing any disruption to your business.

items.question: What makes your IT support services different from other providers?
items.answer: We focus on providing personalized service, fast response times, and a strong understanding of your business. We don’t just solve problems—we work with you to develop an IT strategy that supports your business goals. Our experienced team uses the latest technology to deliver reliable, secure, and efficient IT solutions.

items.question: What IT support services do you offer?
items.answer: We provide a full range of IT support services, including help desk support, network management, cybersecurity solutions, data backup and recovery, cloud services, hardware and software procurement, and IT consulting. Each service is customized to fit the unique needs of your business.
